detail.note: the entry page has no input controls and only 3 clickable element(s) across 9 nodes — usually a bot wall, a consent gate, or a canvas-rendered app with no accessibility tree

detail.why: This is an Amazon interstitial gate page; clicking 'Continue shopping' is required to reach the actual storefront before any book search can happen.

detail.problem: no descriptor resolves uniquely back to this node

detail.why: Scoping the search to the Books department so the results are book listings (the Science-category title we want), not merchandise with the same name.

detail.target: textbox named "Search Amazon" labelledBy "Search Amazon" in frame "root"
detail.why: The main Amazon search box is the entry point for locating a specific book title by name.
The 'Go' button submits the search box query within the selected Books department, taking us to the results list where the specific title can be picked.

The goal specifies the Science category; 'Science & Math' is the Department facet that scopes results to science books, disambiguating the Hawking title from the novels/religious books of the same name.

detail.target: link named "The Grand Design" in frame "root" #0
detail.why: First result under the Science & Math department is 'The Grand Design' by Stephen Hawking; clicking the title link opens the product detail page, which is the authoritative place to read the price.
